national_news.title: 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting Held in New Delhi
bullets: Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav addressed the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi.
India's BRICS chairship is guided by the vision of Building Resilience and Innovation for Cooperation and Sustainability (BRICS), prioritizing the Global South.
Key priorities outlined for India's chairship include Promoting Sustainable Lifestyles, Afforestation, Forest Fire Management, Disaster Resilience, Circular Economy, and Adaptation.
The meeting concluded with the adoption of a Joint Ministerial Statement reaffirming commitment to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, UNFCCC, and the Paris Agreement.

national_news.title: MEA Briefing: India's Election Machinery and Foreign Relations
bullets: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that the credibility and robustness of India's election machinery are well-established globally.
India expressed deep sorrow and offered solidarity and humanitarian assistance to Indonesia following a massive earthquake.
India is examining energy supply requests from Bangladesh, maintaining ongoing bilateral energy cooperation.
India reiterated its firm stance against cross-border terrorism and expressed deep concern over the deteriorating situation and restrictions in Pakistan-Occupied Jammu and Kashmir (POJK).

national_news.title: Supreme Court to Form High-Powered Committee on Delhi Student Protests
bullets: The Supreme Court announced it will constitute a high-powered committee comprising retired apex court and high court judges, a former DGP, and an ex-CBI director.
The committee is tasked with fact-finding regarding allegations of police excesses against student protesters in Delhi and violence against police personnel.
The panel will also investigate allegations of sexual assault, online harassment of female protesters, and victimisation of vulnerable individuals on social media.
Video and CCTV footage of the July 20 Parliament march violence will be handed over to the committee for examination.

national_news.title: Indian Shuttlers Advance at BWF Badminton World Championships
bullets: Lakshya Sen entered the men's singles second round at the BWF Badminton World Championships after defeating Austria's Collins Filimon.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the pre-quarterfinals by defeating the US pair Lauren Lam and Allison Lee.
Unnati Hooda also advanced to the women's singles second round by defeating Myanmar's Thet Htar Thuzar.
The mixed doubles pair Rohan Kapoor and Ruthvika Shivani Gadde bowed out after a first-round defeat against Canada's Jonathan Lai and Crystal Lai.

national_news.title: Rishabh Pant Becomes Fastest Player to Hit 100 Sixes in Test Cricket
bullets: Rishabh Pant became the first Indian player and only the fourth in the world to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.
Pant achieved the milestone in just his 51st Test match during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle, making him the fastest to reach the mark.
Devdutt Padikkal scored 167 runs in India's first-innings total of 462, while Manav Suthar took crucial wickets for India's bowling attack.
The second and final Test of the series is scheduled to be played in Colombo starting from the 23rd of the month.

national_news.title: Uttar Pradesh Government Launches Cashless Medical Scheme and Increases Allowance for PRD Personnel
bullets: The Uttar Pradesh government launched the 'Mukhyamantri PRD Cashless Chikitsa Yojana', providing free medical treatment up to Rs 5 lakh annually for Provincial Armed Guard (PRD) personnel and their families.
Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced an increase in the daily duty allowance for PRD personnel from Rs 500 to Rs 600.
The foundation stone was laid for multi-story PRD barracks in Lucknow to be constructed at an estimated cost of Rs 23 crore.

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Focuses on Integrated Farming and Agricultural Transformation
bullets: The 97th Annual General Meeting of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) Society was held at the National Agricultural Science Complex (NASC), New Delhi, chaired by Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
Emphasized integrated farming systems, timely access to quality seeds, balanced fertilizer use, and improved soil health to diversify and boost incomes of small and marginal farmers.
Stressed transitioning from merely increasing production to building export viability, quality standards, and stronger ICAR-industry partnerships to realize the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.

national_news.title: Shivraj Singh Chouhan Outlines 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' Roadmap for Agriculture and Rural Development
bullets: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan led a commitment programme to translate 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara'—announced by PM Narendra Modi from the Red Fort—into ground action.
The roadmap focuses on integrating the Ministries of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Rural Development to boost agricultural production, quality, and global market compliance.
Key stakeholders including Lakhpati Didis, FPOs, scientists, and Self-Help Groups participated to build a self-reliant and developed India.

national_news.title: India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV Commences
bullets: The 15th edition of the India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV (2026) is conducted from 18 to 31 August 2026 at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp, Surat Thani, Thailand.
Both Indian Army and Royal Thai Army contingents comprise 85 personnel each, with the Indian side represented primarily by the 9 Gorkha Rifles.
Instituted in 2006, the exercise focuses on joint counter-insurgency and terrorist operations in jungle and semi-urban environments under Chapter VII of the UN Charter.

national_news.title: UDISE+ 2025-26 Report Highlights Progress in School Education
bullets: The UDISE+ 2025-26 report covers 14.67 lakh schools, 1.03 crore teachers, and 24.72 crore students across India.
The overall Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) stands at a favorable 24:1, comfortably within the NEP 2020-recommended benchmark of 30:1.
Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) at the Secondary stage improved to 71.7%, while the Middle stage GER stood at 89.6%.

bihar_news.title: India's Carbon Credit Programmes and Smallholder Farmers in Bihar
bullets: Study based on smallholder farmers in Bihar highlights the need for upfront financial support in voluntary carbon credit programmes.
India accounts for approximately 4.1 percent of the global voluntary carbon market.
Smallholders constitute over 80 percent of India's farming population, requiring tailored program designs to lower participation barriers.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Joins Centre's Direct Pulse Procurement Network
bullets: In a first, Bihar joined the Centre's direct pulse procurement network allowing central agencies to procure masoor directly from farmers.
Central agencies like NCCF and Nafed procured 3,000 tonnes of masoor against a target of 32,000 tonnes at an MSP of ₹7,000 per quintal.
Bihar produces nearly 400,000 tonnes of pulses annually across approximately 448,000 hectares.

bihar_news.title: Darbhanga Ranks Second in Bihar for Sugarcane IDs
bullets: Darbhanga emerged as Bihar's second-highest district with 24,215 farmers obtaining Sugarcane IDs under the sugarcane expansion campaign.
West Champaran ranks first in the state for the number of farmers obtaining Sugarcane IDs.
The Sugarcane ID connects farmers to departmental schemes, technical support, and government incentives.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Operations from October 15, Announces CM Samrat Choudhary
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the auction of critical and strategic mineral blocks and the NMEDT workshop organized by the Ministry of Coal and Mines in Patna on August 17, 2026.
The state government announced that more than 30 out of 44 surveyed coal blocks will be allocated before September 30, with active mining operations slated to begin from October 15, 2026.
Key mineral-rich districts identified for optimal resource utilization include Rohtas (limestone), Aurangabad, Jehanabad, Jamui, Gaya, Banka, and Bhagalpur.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announcements on IMC Gaya and World Trade Centre Patna
bullets: Road and water infrastructure for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) will be completed before 2027, with water planned to be brought from Sone to Falgu river.
A World Trade Centre is set to be constructed in Patna to boost trade, industry, and economic activities.
The state government launched initiatives including the 'Vidyarthi Sahyog Portal' to enhance transparency and accountability in the education system.
